behavior.processIsolation: Standalone offline specs inherit neither database configuration nor secret paths; the runner allowlists only PATH, HOME, TMPDIR, LANG, LC_ALL, CI, TERM and NO_COLOR, sets APP_ENV=test and OA_TEST_ISOLATED=true, and preloads the network guard explicitly.
behavior.networkDenial: The general guard hard-denies TCP, HTTP, DNS, TLS, UDP, fetch and PostgreSQL IO before any real IO can occur; the DM diagnostics oracle runs in a separate process under its own all-IO-denying guard so it cannot be bypassed by the other specs.
behavior.coverage: Nineteen offline spec files exercise standard-channel boundaries, group cases/escalations/reminders/contracts, schedules, permission and role administration, artifacts, budgets, data templates/results and signed DWS readers without live credentials.

disclosure: Local component oracles only, executed with all network IO denied and no inherited enterprise configuration. T-cases remain NOT_RUN and R items remain IN_PROGRESS; live GLM, DingTalk, DWS and upstream company-MCP acceptance remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. No live credential, enterprise message, real database or deployment was used.
